Title: Public Preview: Invoke Azure Machine Learning models using the azure_ai extension

Body.Content:
Traditionally, integrating machine learning models with databases has been a complex and cumbersome process. With the new azure_ai extension, now in public preview, we’ve simplified this journey giving you the ability to perform real-time inferences or predictions with low latency right from within the database with a single line of SQL. 

Learn more.
